shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: The only lifted surface — save confirmation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid action: Sign in, Create code, Save, Let in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #1D4ED8; border-radius: 8px; background: #1D4ED8; color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1 "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font: 500 15px/1 "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #F3F4F6; }

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font: 15px/1.45 "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4B5563; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1D4ED8; outline: none; }

components.name: Rail current
components.description: The only accent in the shell.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; color: #4B5563; font: 500 15px/1 "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 36px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #F3F4F6; color: #111827; } .ds-nav-current { background: #EFF6FF; color: #1D4ED8; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Panel
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; } .ds-kpi-label { color: #4B5563; font: 15px/1.45 "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-value { font: 500 40px/1 "Red Hat Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #111827; margin-top: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status chip
components.description: Waiting or stale only — never a default Done.
components.css: .ds-badge { font: 600 12px/1 "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; color: #4B5563; background: #fff; } .ds-badge-warn { color: #B45309; background: #FFFBEB; border-color: #F5D0A6; } .ds-badge-good { color: #047857; background: #ECFDF5; border-color: #A7F3D0; } .ds-badge-bad { color: #B91C1C; background: #FEF2F2; border-color: #FECACA; }

narrative.overview:
`/admin` is a category-standard light operator page, executed at Linear / Stripe Dashboard / Vercel craft. The owner jumps all day between access, health, and people; the rail is always there so that jumping never slows. The iOS member app (dark, ember, haze) is a different identity and does not apply here.

Personality is precise, compact, and unadorned. Color does jobs: blue for the current section and primary actions, green/red/amber only for status. Figures are mono. Surfaces are white on cool gray, separated by a 1px rule.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent 232px white rail, blue-wash current item as the only accent
Source Sans 3 for UI, Red Hat Mono for IDs and figures
Compact density; status color only when something is wrong or waiting

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is current selection and primary action only. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Status-as-Exception Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and amber appear only when the state is not the default. A table of completed rows stays ink.

rules.name: The Mono Figures Rule
rules.body: KPI values, percents, ids, env, event names, and invite codes are Red Hat Mono. Labels stay Source Sans 3.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No glow, glass, or gradient. Shadows only on the toast.

dos: Do keep a persistent rail so jumping Overview / Users / Meals / Invites / Flags / Health is one click.
Do put figures in Red Hat Mono and the current section in the blue wash.
Do use warn color for people waiting and for a stale scheduler.
donts: Don't inherit the iOS ember/haze/dark world on this page.
Don't use glow, glass, gradient text, or pill nav.
Don't color every “Done” or “On” if that is the default — status is the exception.
Don't put chart labels inside an SVG with preserveAspectRatio: none.
